description: Source code for the UserPreferences plugin in a software project, managing UI language settings, migration, and interactions with UserSettings interface.

classes.name: UserPreferences
classes.description: Main class implementing user preferences management, including language conversion, migration, and notification handling.

classes.name: UserPreferences::Notification
classes.description: Nested class handling notifications from UserSettings, particularly language change events.

methods.name: ConvertToUserSettingsFormat
methods.description: Converts UI language string from 'US_en' format to 'en-US' format.

methods.name: ConvertToUserPrefsFormat
methods.description: Converts presentation language string from 'en-US' format to 'US_en' format.

methods.name: PerformMigration
methods.description: Handles migration of language settings, reading/writing to config file and updating UserSettings.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, obtains UserSettings interface, performs migration, and registers notifications.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters notifications, and releases interfaces.

methods.name: getUILanguage
methods.description: Retrieves current UI language, updates config file, and registers for notifications.

methods.name: setUILanguage
methods.description: Sets UI language, converts format, updates UserSettings, and maintains config sync.

methods.name: OnPresentationLanguageChanged
methods.description: Handles presentation language change event, updates config file if needed.
